digest: Triage identified high-severity specification violations, public API contract mismatch, and race conditions across stop handling, cancellation, and terminal summary modules.

reviewLenses.focus: Stop signal timing, polling bounds, disk read error propagation, and concurrency/race condition handling
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: src/workflow-stop.ts violates S3 with incorrect poll interval defaults (200ms vs 50ms) and minimum clamps (1ms vs 10ms), lacks overlapping async poll protection, permits post-dispose abort mutations violating S5, and matches error messages instead of exact error names violating S6.

reviewLenses.focus: Provider cancellation error classification and recursive JSON parsing safety
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: src/workflow-cancellation.ts treats 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as cancellations violating C1, and relies on reference identity comparison (parsed !== value) which fails to prevent infinite recursion on cyclical parsed JSON structures violating C2.

reviewLenses.focus: Workflow terminal summary schema contract and dynamic mode semantic status resolution
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: src/workflow-terminal.ts exposes 'launchRetries' instead of the public contract property 'launchRetryAttempts' violating T3, and risks runtime exceptions if task file descriptors are missing.

reviewLenses.focus: Absence of automated unit test suite verifying stop, cancellation, and terminal behaviors
reviewLenses.whyNeeded: SPEC.md requirement Q1 mandates unit tests covering all S, C, and T specification items, but no test suite currently exists in the repository.

triageSummary: Triage of src/ against SPEC.md revealed multiple critical and high-priority defects: (1) workflow-stop.ts uses pollMs default of 200ms and minimum of 1ms instead of 50ms/10ms (S3), evaluates error messages rather than strict error names (S6), allows overlapping async setInterval executions, and lacks a disposed guard for in-flight disk reads (S5); (2) workflow-cancellation.ts accepts 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as cancellation strings (C1) and uses ineffective reference comparison to avoid cycle recursion (C2); (3) workflow-terminal.ts breaks the public API contract by naming the retry property 'launchRetries' instead of 'launchRetryAttempts' (T3); and (4) no unit tests are present (Q1).
skippedLenses: safety/security: No remote untrusted input execution or credential handling in scope
migration/cross-repo: Scope is strictly self-contained within src/ and SPEC.md
